summary: agentaix ships import-time C2 backdoor with Windows Run-key persistence
details: On import, agentaix executes install_manage() which renames the bundled src/agentaix/readme.txt to manage.py and silently launches it via pythonw. The smuggled script registers the host as username@hostname with https://googleforum.pythonanywhere.com/api/register, polls /api/client/{client_id}/poll for commands, and dispatches handlers named exec, download, upload, delete, rename, open, and list — providing arbitrary shell command execution and full remote file-manager access on the installer's machine. _add_to_startup writes the registry value HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\AgentAIXManage pointing to pythonw and manage.py, re-launching the C2 client on every user login so the compromise persists beyond the install session. The payload is disguised as readme.txt and declared as package-data in pyproject.toml to evade name-based review of PyPI contents.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
